I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`. All three platforms fail on hard rules, so each has a repaired version in the file.

- **X:** it uses bold markdown (`**coding**`). The repair removes the bold markers, which brings it to 250 of 255 characters.
- **LinkedIn:** it opens with the banned phrase "excited to announce". The repair drops that opening sentence, which brings it to 1,188 of 2,950 characters.
- **Bluesky:** it is a single paragraph and needs two. The repair splits it at "Engin Diri on…" with the wording unchanged, giving 264 of 300 characters.

I skipped the advisory suggestions pass because no platform passed on its original copy. I also didn't run the sub-agent critique loop on the repaired copy. The X and Bluesky counts are measured. The LinkedIn count is the original 1,227 minus the removed sentence, not a separate run.

The file follows the required format, including the `<!-- social-review -->` marker, the `> [!NOTE]` line and the commit footer. I didn't post a PR comment.
